answers.core: It requires direct modifications to the engine core (expose ScriptServer) and the editor (EditorNode icon methods, EditorFileSystem FileCache exposure).
answers.workaround: There is no performance-sensitive means by which to do this in the scripting API. This proposal is about updating the scripting API's capabilities to accommodate the performance problems that can occur at scale.

title: Simplify scripting API "type" and "icon" data acquisition for scripts and scenes
